Due to this wrong commitment and sudden change, my financial planning has been badly affected. This has created unnecessary financial pressure on me.

The sales team appears totally uncommitted to their promises and keeps changing statements after financial processing is completed. Buyers invest their hard-earned money based on trust and transparency, and such behavior is extremely disappointing.

Very bad experience. I strongly advise all buyers to take every commitment in written form before making any purchase decision.
